common_documents.title: Fictional demo policy excerpt, not a complete contract
common_documents.text: FICTIONAL DEMO POLICY. For this fictional nonurgent imaging service, the submitted request must include a clinician-signed referral and a clinician-signed record of a six-week conservative-treatment course. This excerpt does not establish whether the imaging is clinically appropriate or whether other policy terms permit coverage. The full contract, definitions and exclusions have not been supplied.

common_documents.title: Fictional denial, no real insurer
common_documents.text: FICTIONAL DEMO DENIAL. We have not approved request DEMO-001 for the fictional nonurgent imaging service. The submitted materials do not contain a clinician-signed record documenting completion of the six-week conservative-treatment course described in the supplied fictional policy excerpt. You may ask us to reconsider with the missing documentation. This fictional notice does not specify a deadline.

common_documents.text: FICTIONAL DEMO REFERRAL. Clinician A recommends evaluation of the fictional imaging request. This fixture represents a signed referral. It does not itself document completion of conservative treatment or establish clinical necessity.
